links.comparator_used: Logistic regression/probability-based stratification using multi-polygenic risk scores without Mondrian Cross-Conformal Prediction
links.outcome: Predictive performance and reliability/uncertainty-aware prediction across ancestries for nephropathy, stroke, and myocardial infarction in type 2 diabetes
links.effect: MCCP did not improve performance; it issued per-individual confidence and credibility, allowed a tolerated error level to be set in advance, delivered prediction sets respecting it in the majority of settings, and flagged individuals for whom no reliable prediction could be made. No numerical performance effect reported in the abstract.
links.quote: On top of this baseline, MCCP did not improve performance but added capabilities absent from probability-based stratification: for each individual, it issued a prediction together with an explicit confidence and credibility level; it allowed a tolerated error level to be set in advance and delivered prediction sets respecting it in the majority of settings; and it flagged individuals for whom no reliable prediction could be made.

design_hint: conformal prediction uncertainty flagging of unreliable predictions
